summary: Added a shell-free worktree status payload that reports ledger-associated path, branch, lane, disk bytes, and stale state without invoking Git. Added real temporary-repository coverage for live and stale worktrees and verified repository metadata remains unchanged.

files_changed.why: Defines the read-only worktree status payload and ledger-backed collector.
Covers live and stale temporary Git worktrees, disk bytes, associations, and non-mutation.

done_criteria.criterion: Tests use temporary repositories/directories and assert stale and live cases.
done_criteria.evidence: internal/serve/worktrees_test.go:16-86 uses t.TempDir-backed repositories and real linked worktrees; go test ./internal/serve -run '^TestListWorktreesReportsLiveAndStaleEntriesWithoutRepositoryMutation$' -count=1 passed.

done_criteria.criterion: Only the two allowed paths change and the commit is recorded.
done_criteria.evidence: git show --stat --oneline 57fa2c4 reports exactly internal/serve/worktrees.go and internal/serve/worktrees_test.go; commit 57fa2c46f60dce897be34bcc3c0dfbb683a1feec records the work.

findings.finding: Disk-byte collection recursively stats every file in each recorded worktree, so collection cost scales with worktree size.
findings.affects: Future polling frequency for the serve status surface.
